title: SANTA runner results (santa-runner-results/v1)
description: What a self-contained runner writes to <out-dir>/results.json after grading its implementation against a SANTA checkout (runner-integration §4.3): the commit graded against, the scope, per slice the files graded, the dimension counts, the outcome counts and one record per red. The raw actuals sit beside it in <out-dir>/actuals/<path>; SANTA's canary re-grades those, not this file's verdicts.

santa.description: The SANTA commit graded against (`git -C <santa-dir> rev-parse HEAD`); null when <santa-dir> is not a git checkout. conform refuses results graded against a commit other than its own.

scope.description: The scope graded at: the runner.json scope keys (runner-integration §2).

slices.description: One per slice with a graded file, keyed "<tier>/<version>/<provenance>".

red.description: The red records over all slices.

not_implemented.description: The not-implemented entries over all slices.

path.description: A vector file, by its path relative to vectors/.

files.description: The vector files graded in this slice (conform checks them against its own selection: the completeness check).

dims.description: Per graded dimension (docs/contract/grading.md §4): how many entries it graded and how many were nice. A dimension an entry does not grade (n/a) is not counted.

red.description: One record per red: a red dimension of an entry, or an entry whose outcome is not-implemented, panicked or exceeded.

expected.description: A short rendering of the expected answer, for people; never compared.

got.description: A short rendering of the actual answer, for people; never compared.

note.description: A panic's message, or another diagnostic.
